
Those draws keep the specification fixed. They do not tell you which inputs to
include or which carryover and saturation functions to use. To explore those
choices by hand, an analyst fits a model, checks it, and tries another. In this
scenario, analyst choices based on assumptions act as a discrete sampler.
